survey.html:
Thank you for your interest in our survey! Your responses today will help insurance companies understand how to provide better service to your business. In accordance with our privacy policy, your responses to all questions in this survey will be kept confidential and used for research purposes only.
The survey should take approximately 15-17 minutes to complete.

radio.title: Is your business headquartered in the U.S?

South: West Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, Virginia, District of Columbia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi, Alabama, Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana

radio.title: ${progHoverOverCSS.r2.text}Which of the following best describes your function in your business?
radio.row: Other Finance (treasure, finance manager, accountant, bookkeeper, payroll, etc.)

Administrative Staff (coordinator, clerk, administrator, specialist, developer, representative, etc.)

radio.title: Which of the following best describes your business?

radio.label: S09
radio.title: In addition to yourself, how many full-time employees does your company employ across locations? By "full-time employees," we mean those who work 30 hours or more each week.

radio.label: S10
radio.title: What was your company's overall total commercial insurance premium in 2025 across all different coverages, including different carriers? Please only include property and casualty business insurance (P&C), NOT health insurance or employee benefits and estimate to the best of your ability.

radio.label: hS10qta

radio.label: S11
radio.title: What is your role in making insurance decisions for your company? By insurance decisions, we mean selecting or managing your company's Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance products, excluding employee health/dental benefits.
radio.row: I am the sole decision-maker for all P&C insurance decisions for the organization
I share in the P&C insurance decision-making
I can influence P&C insurance decisions
I am not involved in P&C insurance decisions

radio.label: S12

radio.row: Determining the types of insurance your company needs, or working with an agent or broker to determine this
Choosing which carrier(s) to get your policies from
Getting your account and policies started and set up
Making changes to your policy throughout the year – such as adding vehicles, entering into new insurance contracts, etc.
Managing other service needs relative to your policy – such as requesting certificates or asking questions
Reviewing and/or paying your insurance premium
Participating in ${pgHover.r4.text}, loss control, or risk prevention

radio.row: Group Benefits (e.g., life insurance, short-term disability insurance, long-term disability insurance and long-term care)

html.b: The next few questions are about the interactions you have with your business insurance carrier(s) and/or agents/brokers that you work with when managing your company’s business insurance.

radio.row: Accessing insurance information through a customer portal
Getting answers to coverage and policy questions
Service that adapts as my business needs change

radio.label: A02

Accessing insurance information and policy documents
Identifying emerging risks and coverage gaps

checkbox.col: Online text-based chat with a person
Speaking with an AI-enabled tool (such as an ${pgHover.r3.text} or voice-enabled chat)
Self-service on an online portal (without interacting with anyone)
checkbox.row: Getting support throughout the claims process
Managing business risk and loss prevention

Identifying emerging risks and coverage gaps

It is important that my carrier(s) demonstrates an understanding of my specific company
I wish my carrier(s) would leverage my company's data to provide better insights and recommendations
I feel more supported when my agent/broker and carrier work together
I feel more valued by my agent/broker than I do by my carrier(s)
I feel frustrated when I need to repeat information between my broker and carrier.
Carriers lose my trust when they make errors in day-to-day servicing needs, such as billing or certificate mistakes
I want my carrier(s) to go beyond the day-to-day insurance administration tasks and provide strategic recommendations regarding my insurance and ${pgHover.r4.text} needs
I prefer to interact only with my broker, not my insurance carrier
I am not sure who to contact if I needed assistance from my carrier(s)
I would be more likely to log into my carrier's portal if it offered more self-service tools (e.g., access to policies, certificates, ability to make changes)
I would be more likely to log into my carrier's portal if it offered more personalized information
Language used by insurance carriers is often difficult to understand
I want reassurance that the coverage my business has is appropriate for its needs
I prefer to immerse myself in as much detailed insurance information as possible
A smooth renewal process makes me feel more confident about engaging with the carrier during the policy year
My carrier(s) make me feel like just another policyholder rather than a valued customer
When working with my carrier(s), I prefer having a single point of contact that can connect me to the right expertise regardless of the issue

    <script type="text/javascript">
function showTooltip(e,id){
if (!e) var e = window.event;
var element;
if (e.srcElement) element = e.srcElement;
else element = e.target;
var scrollAmount;
var scrollAmtLeft;

if (window.pageYOffset != undefined) scrollAmount = window.pageYOffset ;
else scrollAmount = document.documentElement.scrollTop;
if (window.pageXOffset != undefined)  scrollAmtLeft = window.pageXOffset ;
else scrollAmtLeft = document.documentElement.scrollLeft;
scrollAmount = 0;
//alert("scrollAmount" + scrollAmount)

x = e.clientX + scrollAmtLeft;
y = e.clientY + scrollAmount;
//console.log("e.clientX " + e.clientX);
//console.log("e.target.id " + e.target.id);
var divHeight = parseInt(y) + parseInt(document.getElementById(id).clientHeight);
var divWidth = parseInt(y) + parseInt(document.getElementById(id).clientWidth);
var screenHeight = parseInt(document.documentElement.clientHeight) + scrollAmount;
var screenWidth = parseInt(document.documentElement.clientWidth) + scrollAmtLeft;
var nonScrollHeight = parseInt(document.documentElement.clientHeight);
var nonScrollWidth = parseInt(document.documentElement.clientWidth);
//alert("Screen width = " + screenWidth);
document.getElementById(id).style.display = "block";
var actualHeight = parseInt(document.getElementById(id).clientHeight)
var actualWidth = parseInt(document.getElementById(id).clientWidth)
var xOffset = 50;
var yOffset = 5;
var buffer = 3;


//alert('scroll height ' + parseInt(nonScrollHeight));
//alert('div height ' + parseInt(y + yOffset + actualHeight + buffer));
//if (y + yOffset + actualHeight + scrollAmount + buffer > screenHeight){
if (parseInt(y + yOffset + actualHeight + buffer) > screenHeight){
if (parseInt(y - actualHeight - buffer - yOffset) > 0) document.getElementById(id).style.top = parseInt(y - actualHeight - yOffset) + "px";
else document.getElementById(id).style.top = parseInt(screenHeight - actualHeight) + "px";
}
else document.getElementById(id).style.top = parseInt(y+yOffset) + "px";

//alert("document.getElementById(id).style.top" + document.getElementById(id).style.top)

//document.getElementById(id).style.top = parseInt(y+yOffset) + "px";
//if (x + xOffset + actualWidth + buffer > screenWidth){

if (parseInt(x + actualWidth + xOffset + buffer) > screenWidth){
//alert('0 check ' + parseInt(x - actualWidth - buffer - xOffset));
if (parseInt(x - actualWidth - buffer - xOffset) > 0) document.getElementById(id).style.left =  parseInt(x - actualWidth - xOffset)+ "px";
else document.getElementById(id).style.left =  parseInt(screenWidth - actualWidth)+ "px";
}
else document.getElementById(id).style.left = parseInt(x+xOffset) + "px";
//alert('left ' + document.getElementById(id).style.left);

}    
function hideToolTip(id){
document.getElementById(id).style.display = "none";
}    
    </script>
